about: What Beamline ships, one entry per component, each with an SPDX licence (docs/architecture.md 5.1 A, 6.34). scripts/notices.py makes the app's assets/notices/ from it and checks it against what ships (--check). 'covers' names the Maven modules (group:name, a trailing * matches a prefix) an entry accounts for; 'checked' says where the licence was read. Copyright lines are given only where they were read in the component's own licence file.

libandroidx.graphics.path.so.basis: the library (10 KB, arm64) links only libc, libdl and libm and holds no third-party marker; its sources (androidx graphics/graphics-path/src/main/cpp, read on androidx-main: Conic, Path, PathIterator, pathway, scalar) are Android Open Source Project files under Apache-2.0

libsqliteJni.so.basis: sqlite-bundled compiles the SQLite amalgamation with AndroidX's JNI glue (the AAR's own LICENSE.txt is Apache-2.0)

libmaplibre.so.basis: the OpenGL build of MapLibre Native android-v13.7.1 (org.maplibre.gl:android-sdk-opengl 13.7.1, beamline.mapRenderer=opengl since the owner's decision of 2026-11-16): CMakeLists.txt's mbgl-core link list (kdbush, shelf-pack-cpp, geojson-vt-cpp, cheap-ruler-cpp, boost, earcut, eternal, parsedate, pmtiles, polylabel, protozero, supercluster, unique_resource, vector-tile, wagyu, mlt-cpp with FSST and FastPFOR, csscolorparser as MLN_USE_RUST is off, FreeType and HarfBuzz as MLN_TEXT_SHAPING_HARFBUZZ is on, MapLibreNative::Base with geojson.hpp, geometry.hpp and variant, expected-lite, rapidjson, unordered_dense; tracy and metal-cpp off), platform/android/android.cmake (jni.hpp, ICU, SQLite; zlib, EGL, GLES, log and jnigraphics are the system's); the NDK's libc++ statically. vendor/vulkan.cmake (Vulkan-Headers, VulkanMemoryAllocator, glslang, SPIRV) is linked only by the Vulkan build (org.maplibre.gl:android-sdk), which Beamline does not ship: track A counted 0 glslang, SPIR-V, VMA and Vulkan marker strings in the OpenGL arm64 library. Marker strings in the arm64 library confirm SQLite, ICU 61, FreeType, HarfBuzz, PMTiles, FSST, FastPFOR, protozero, supercluster, Boost and libc++abi. MapLibre's own LICENSE.md omits ICU, SQLite, HarfBuzz, PMTiles, unordered_dense, jni.hpp and the MLT code; those were read at their pinned commits (data/r3-a/notices/upstream/maplibre/).

libvalhalla-wrapper.so.basis: valhalla-mobile 0.6.4's vcpkg.json (protobuf, boost, robin-hood-hashing, rapidjson, lz4, abseil, unordered-dense; abseil and protobuf build paths are in the arm64 library) and Valhalla 3.9.1's own third_party code on its library's include path (date with the IANA tz data, embedded; cpp-statsd-client; vtzero with protozero; flatbush; unordered_dense; rapidjson). Not in it: OSM-binary (LGPL, used only by the data builder), libosmium, microtar (none of their strings), cxxopts and just_gtfs (tools and GTFS import). zlib is the system's (libz.so); the NDK's libc++ is linked statically.
